items.raw_excerpt: People living in the west Essex town describe the division which is now felt by some locals.
items.summary_en: A year ago, there were protests about asylum seekers in Epping, a small town in Essex, England. People living there say the town is still divided. Some locals still feel the effects of the protests today.
items.summary_ko: 1년 전 영국 에식스의 작은 마을 에핑에서 망명 신청자를 둘러싼 시위가 있었습니다. 그곳에 사는 주민들은 마을이 아직도 분열되어 있다고 말합니다. 일부 지역 주민들은 그 시위의 여파를 아직도 느끼고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Epping asylum seeker protests: a town still divided one year on

items.raw_excerpt: After the Peak District signed a brand deal with Skoda, could other national parks follow suit?
items.summary_en: The Peak District national park signed a brand deal with Skoda. The deal brings in money, but some people criticize it. Other national parks may now follow the same idea.

items.raw_excerpt: Many are first time voters have encouraged other young people to make use of this final opportunity
items.summary_en: Many young people in Soweto are lining up to collect ID documents so they can register to vote. Some are first-time voters and are encouraging other young people to use this final chance to sign up.

items.raw_excerpt: PLANS to build 26 homes within the grounds of a single property close to Victoria Village in Trinity have been rejected because of the impact of the development on nearby lanes. The 4.2-vergée site called La Ruette next to the Eric Young Orchid Foundation sits within the ‘built-up area’ – where there is a presumption […]
items.summary_en: A plan to build 26 homes on one property near Victoria Village in Trinity has been turned down. Officials said the new homes would hurt nearby lanes and local roads. The site sits next to the Eric Young Orchid Foundation.
items.summary_ko: 저지 섬 트리니티의 빅토리아 빌리지 근처 한 부지에 주택 26채를 짓는 계획이 거절됐습니다. 당국은 새 주택들이 주변 골목길과 지역 도로에 나쁜 영향을 줄 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 해당 부지는 에릭 영 난초 재단 옆에 있습니다.
items.title_en: Plan to build 26 homes in Trinity is rejected over traffic worries

items.title_original: Victoria Village homes plan rejected over impact of traffic on local roads - Jersey Evening Post

items.raw_excerpt: NPR asked an aspiring scientist in Philadelphia to interview an adult who is living his dream about his career in conservation science.
items.summary_en: An NPR reporter asked a first grader in Philadelphia to interview an adult who is living his dream. The boy chose a scientist who works in conservation science. It is a sweet story about a child meeting his hero.
items.summary_ko: NPR은 필라델피아의 1학년 학생에게 꿈을 이루며 사는 어른을 인터뷰해 달라고 부탁했습니다. 그 학생은 자연 보호 과학 분야에서 꿈을 이루고 사는 새 박사를 골랐습니다. 어린이가 자신의 영웅을 직접 만나는 사랑스러운 이야기입니다.
items.title_en: A first grader in Philadelphia interviewed his hero, a bird scientist

items.raw_excerpt: Temperatures are expected to climb to as high as 20°C in parts of South Iceland today. Meanwhile, strong wind gusts remain a hazard in eastern areas of the country. According to the Icelandic Meteorological Office, most of Iceland will see generally bright conditions under northerly winds of 3–10 m/s. However, the east will experience northwesterly…
items.summary_en: Temperatures could reach as high as 20 degrees in parts of South Iceland today. Strong wind gusts remain a hazard in the east. Most of Iceland should see bright conditions under light northerly winds.
items.summary_ko: 오늘 아이슬란드 남부 일부 지역에서는 낮 기온이 20도까지 오를 것으로 보입니다. 한편 동부 지역에서는 강한 돌풍이 여전히 위험 요소로 남아 있습니다. 기상청에 따르면 북풍이 초속 3에서 10미터로 불며 아이슬란드 대부분 지역에서 대체로 화창한 날씨를 보이겠습니다.
items.title_en: Bright Weather for Most of Iceland as Temperatures Climb to 20C

items.raw_excerpt: Taking place in Vestmannaeyjar (Westman Islands), Þjóðhátíð, or National Festival, is the pinnacle of the country’s long weekend, known as Verslunarmannahelgi (Shop Workers’ Weekend). The event is centred around Commerce Day, a public holiday for all shopkeepers and retail industry professionals. Both events go back to 1874 when the country celebrated the millennium of Icelandic…
items.summary_en: Icelanders gather on the Westman Islands for the National Festival, called Thjodhatid. It marks the long weekend named after Shop Workers' Day. The festival started in 1874, when Iceland celebrated its history a thousand years ago.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드 사람들은 서부 제도인 베스트만나에이야르로 모여 민족 축제를 즐깁니다. 이 축제는 상점 직원들의 날인 상업의 날을 중심으로 한 긴 주말에 열립니다. 이 축제는 아이슬란드 역사 천년을 기념했던 1874년부터 시작되었습니다.
items.title_en: A Big Island Party: Iceland's National Festival
items.title_ko: 작은 섬의 큰 축제, 아이슬란드 민족 축제

items.raw_excerpt: The Polytechnic Institute of Santarém (IPSantarém) will be renamed the Polytechnic University of Santarém starting 1 August, a change aligned with the new legal framework for higher education, it was announced.
items.summary_en: The Polytechnic Institute of Santarém will be renamed the Polytechnic University of Santarém. The change starts on 1 August. It follows a new law for higher education in Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 산타렘 폴리테크닉 대학이 폴리테크닉 대학교로 이름을 바꾼다. 8월 1일부터 새 이름을 쓰기 시작한다. 이번 변경은 포르투갈의 고등교육 새 법률에 따른 것이다.
items.title_en: College in Santarém gets a new name

items.summary_en: This article is about Joseph of Leonissa, a Catholic saint who lived in Italy from 1556 to 1612. He was known for his preaching and his care for poor people. The piece recalls his life and how he is remembered in Leonissa.
items.summary_ko: 이 기사는 1556년부터 1612년까지 이탈리아에서 살았던 가톨릭 성인 요셉에 관한 것입니다. 그는 설교와 가난한 사람들을 돌보는 일로 잘 알려져 있습니다. 기사는 그의 삶과 레오니사 지역에서 그를 기억하는 방식을 소개합니다.
items.title_en: The Life of Saint Joseph of Leonissa

items.raw_excerpt: Devotees at Mahankali Bonalu face 4-5 hour waits due to heavy crowds and VIP movement, sparking frustration and calls for better management.
items.summary_en: Devotees at the Mahankali Bonalu festival in Hyderabad wait 4-5 hours because of heavy crowds and VIP movement. They are frustrated and ask for better crowd management.

items.summary_en: A new series explores the beautiful coastline of Cornwall. It features Port Isaac, a small fishing village. The village became famous as the home of the TV show Doc Martin.
